summary: OpenText filed an 8-K reporting two routine financing actions: a third amendment extending its revolving credit facility maturity from December 19, 2028 to October 1, 2031, and the issuance of $500 million of 6.700% senior secured notes due 2031 plus $500 million of 7.150% senior secured notes due 2033 via Rule 144A/Reg S private placement. Proceeds are general corporate purposes, not deal-funding. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, tender, or going-private event is disclosed. This is ordinary debt capital-markets and credit-agreement activity, warranting a None classification; no arb angle.
